name: idle-vivarium-ferns-dusk-t
refs: IMAGE 1, THE PICTURE TO RELIGHT (this room's signed day): keep everything, relight only:
prompt: Output a NEW image, 16:9: Image 1 at a different time of day. No lamps, no glow. Keep Image 1 EXACTLY the same in composition and content: every plant, stone, root, leaf, the ground's shapes and levels, in the same places and sizes, in the same hand-painted miniature finish; change ONLY the light and its colour. Do not move, add or remove anything. No creatures, no text.
